description: Picks one label from your list (2 to 20 labels) for a piece of text. Returns { label, labels }: the chosen label (one of yours, or null if none fit) and the labels sent. Price: 3 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

labels.description: Candidate labels, 2 to 20, each 1 to 40 characters; the answer is always one of these or null.

text.description: Text to process, 1 to 8,000 characters. Emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SINs and IPv4s are redacted before the model sees it.

name: classify
title: Classify
